item.title: Get Weird
item.description:
Now What?

Maybe you can feel it. The enshittification. The suits breathing down your neck to adopt a broken technology meant to replace you and deny you access to information save through their filters and their control. An assualt on the craft and creativity that used to be part and parcel of being a weirdo tech enthusiast.

OpenAI’s Super Bowl ad was an unwitting(?) tell - give us all your curiosity, all your attempts at learning, all your triumphs of insight, and we’ll give you back a chat box. That’s all you need. That’s all you are. It does everything you can. Better. Faster. More obediently.
